query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM (
                SELECT p.id
                FROM permissions p
                JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id
                JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id
                WHERE ur.user_id = $1 AND ur.is_active = TRUE AND p.name = $2
                UNION
                SELECT p.id
                FROM permissions p
                JOIN user_permissions up ON p.id = up.permission_id
                WHERE up.user_id = $1 AND up.is_active = TRUE AND p.name = $2
            ) AS user_perms
